cue.heading: Wilkinson v. Dotson (2005), Scalia, J., concurring
cue.quote: It is one thing to say that permissible habeas relief, as our cases interpret the statute, includes ordering a “quantum change in the level of custody,” … such as release from incarceration to parole.
